description: This file contains code for generating a localized search placeholder text, including internationalization setup, fetching total records from Algolia, and writing the placeholder to a JSON file.

methods.name: roundDownToNearestHundred
methods.description: Rounds a number down to the nearest hundred.

methods.name: convertToLocalizedString
methods.description: Converts a number to a localized string based on ISO code.

methods.name: generateSearchPlaceholder
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a search placeholder text based on total records, localizes it, and writes it to a JSON file.
